option_checks.evidence: Under the stated approximately uniform unconstrained membrane/static conditions, near-spherical shape is the relevant qualitative no-preferred-direction observation.
Macroscopic equilibrium does not stop microscopic motion/impacts. Applying bulk rest to molecules generates the false zero-collision explanation.
F=pS: unequal areas do not generally receive equal normal force at equal pressure. Dropping the area factor reproduces the erroneous claim.
At one position equal pressure times equal area yields equal normal force magnitudes, while each force's direction follows its surface orientation.

Local isotropy does not imply spatial homogeneity; hydrostatic gas pressure can vary with height. Replacing orientation at a fixed point with another spatial point creates the false universal implication.
